hold_merge: QW2-VM8P4 proof vehicle; the slice2 W parent (w6 VM8Q_VIEW) absorbs it
structural_change: QW2-VM8P4 10-21 P4 successor of P3 vm8q / vm8qb (in-flow ep6: ONE clock root over 1.43 mm, parent flop arrival 1.2..2.2 ns vs hard-child insertion 333-485 ps -> post-CTS setup -460 / -522 ps SS on ~9.6k endpoints, repair 0 buffers = skew). P4 = landed parent: 10 regional CTS roots (va vb vc pg | cl ch bt | fc fb fv), every cross-region net an lp landing (D4/E2, chunk 24, shared rings), regional reset runs with kept copies. Lockstep landed == flat qfd_dv_s5_vm8rf (lp bench) and flat == vm8fh (P3 tb). Price vs flat vm8rf: VM answers +3 (writes +3, write->read distance unchanged), PROG +0, BTAB / CROM +6, reset release +5. MAIN: P3 geometry (1425.6 x 993.6, S band 129.6, 86.4 column channels, 155-um inter-row channel); landing rings in the S band / channels
